# PCA95x5 I²C port expander library

Litch uses a modified [PCA95x5 header](../../lib/PCA95x5/) by Hideaki Tai under the [MIT license](../../lib/PCA95x5/LICENSE). Upstream v0.1.2 and v0.1.3 contain identical copies of the imported header. The [vendor comparison manifest](../../tools/vendor/sources.json) pins v0.1.3 as the comparison baseline and identifies the modified file.

The [vendor comparison tool](../../tools/vendor/README.md) verifies the copy against upstream. See the [I²C bus map](../hardware/bus_devices.md) for expander addresses and the [third-party notices](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for attribution.
